map.live_or_comparison_boundary: API block size is not total latency; distinguish adaptive playout from user-selected speed control.

assets: Task-local synthetic traces and virtual clocks only; no PCM, corpus, weights, network capture, device or licensed runtime is added by this survey.
comparison_inputs: Twelve matched virtual-clock traces at nominal, +/-1000 ppm, a 400 ms delivery hold and release, +60,000 ppm and a 1 s hold; source coordinates are millionths of a source sample and output coordinates are nominal 16 kHz playout samples.
Variable-count elastic fixture chunks of 80/160/240 samples with exact Fraction source-to-output maps, a bounded pending-input limit and a finite drain.
No RTP timestamp sequence, receive-side arrival log or NetEq trace is present in the reviewed pins.
controls: Controller target is 3200 source samples (200 ms), capacity is 9600 (600 ms), the proportional law is quantized to integer ppm, clamped to [0.95, 1.05] and slewed by at most 50 ppm/tick (0.5 percentage points/s); fixed 1x playback is the matched control.

Playback starts at target; a queue that cannot cover a full nonfinal block enters rebuffer with no source consumption, output content or new rate command, and an over-capacity arrival is rejected whole.

The elastic fixture rejects invalid ratios and noncontiguous starts with zero consumption, rejects full-queue input as rejected_backpressure without dropping older input, and exposes no jitter-buffer reordering.
limits: No receive timestamp domain, sequence reordering, loss-driven delay target, concealment decision or codec integration is executed by an adaptive buffer.
Virtual ticks are not wall time; no device underrun, callback deadline, buffer fill/flush or availability measurement exists.

local_outcomes.finding: Mean absolute live queue error was 12.569 versus 240.800 source samples at +1000 ppm and 17.806 versus 133.483 at -1000 ppm; a 400 ms delivery hold produced one 3360-sample (210 ms) rebuffer in both runs; +60,000 ppm overflowed at virtual sample 241280 versus 109280. These are non-qualifying virtual-clock controls, not device results.

The elastic fixture maps 80/160/240-sample chunks exactly at ratio 1, changes only later chunks after a 1 -> 2 ratio update, produces a finite 320-sample tail at ratio 0.5 and separates single-erasure parity from PCM; it does not implement a jitter buffer or playout pacing.

reported_outcomes.finding: S41 documents NetEq reordering, delay and time-scaling concepts; the registry pins no NetEq revision, trace or measured result.

assets: Generated synthetic stimuli only; no recording, corpus, model, third-party binary, licensed runtime or device is used.
comparison_inputs: Synthetic source-timestamped schedules at 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 0.8x and 0.9x for the offline OLA/WSOLA fixture; rational atempo schedules including 5/4, 4/5, 3/2, 3/4 and 11/10; controller speed commands within +/-5%.
Synthetic 512-sample-grain streaming frames at the fixed 160-sample v0 boundary, plus whole-clip feeds.
Rebuffer, drift, final-partial and transient locations are synthetic and source-timestamped.
controls: Identity 1x passthrough; fixed 1x against the occupancy controller; unsmoothed rate step and varispeed are explicit adverse controls, never substitutes.
Declared rate domain, monotone source maps, bounded FIFO, finite drain and exact target-length checks.
Controller output is capped at +/-5% and slewed; these are automatic playout corrections, not user-selected speed changes.
limits: No adaptive playout controller is wired to a real packet-arrival process; no device clock, underrun or recovery measurement exists.
Fixed-rate and user-selected time-scale evidence cannot be pooled with automatic jitter or drift correction.

local_outcomes.finding: Offline OLA/WSOLA cases mapped identity 19200 -> 19200, 1.25x -> 15360, 1.5x -> 12800, 0.8x -> 24000 and 0.9x -> 21333 with zero duration error; a 1600-sample uncompensated rebuffer deficit and a transient proxy of 102 versus 40 samples remain recorded gates.

Streaming OLA/WSOLA passed 32/32 tests but its duration relative error +0.0367552310 fails the proposed 1 ms/s gate; an 800-sample input interruption drained 32 buffered samples and refilled 128, and first output appeared at input frame 3 (30 ms).

The atempo reference reached exact target output length with zero duration error for every rational schedule; rebuffer and final-partial behavior are synthetic tick models, not FFmpeg parity or device timing.

reported_outcomes.finding: S41 supplies the NetEq time-scaling lead; no local NetEq acceleration, deceleration or stretch execution is recorded.

assets: Generated surrogate signals only; no Opus library, packet trace, network capture, weights, corpus or listening panel is used.
comparison_inputs: Frozen synthetic 16 kHz mono f32 160-sample frames; 250-frame / 40,000-sample cohorts with fixed erasure masks and a 2.5 s stream.
Erasure masks include isolated, two-frame and four-frame bursts across voiced, unvoiced and silence strata.
controls: Identity clean delivery, zero fill, hold and linear interpolation; the decoder-style candidate is never substituted for a codec output.
Concealed slots carry result flag 4 with valid_count=0 and cannot satisfy sample conservation; stale, duplicate, out-of-order, nonfinite, short, missing and bad-shape frames are rejected.
Maximum four-frame burst; the 800-sample host buffer is an adapter scheduling choice, not intrinsic candidate delay.
limits: All PLC fixtures run at the host delivery-adapter boundary; none is integrated with a reordering jitter buffer, loss-driven delay target or codec decoder.
No rights-cleared speech, independent listening or held-out generalization is available.

local_outcomes.finding: Linear interpolation scored 11.820617 dB SI-SDR and 0.949594 STOI versus zero fill at 10.983909 dB and 0.951020 on one frozen synthetic cohort; this improves SI-SDR but not STOI and is not a perceptual result.
Pitch-period repeat scored 22.139532 dB SI-SDR and 0.851298 STOI versus zero fill at 13.589343 / 0.807333; it remained a synthetic candidate with no held-out or listening result.
Zero fill scored 11.790410 dB SI-SDR and 0.876922 STOI and regressed against hold by 0.117563 dB SI-SDR and 0.000352 lost-region RMSE, recorded as an explicit gate.

The decoder-PLC-style surrogate scored 11.089522 dB SI-SDR and 0.946857 STOI; it lost SI-SDR and lost-region RMSE to all three controls while gaining STOI, and no Opus codec or packet trace was executed.

reported_outcomes.finding: S41 names PLC as part of NetEq playout; no local codec-native PLC integration or jitter-buffer concealment decision is recorded.

findings: The registry records 'No ML requirement' for ENG-03; no learned jitter-buffer, delay estimator or playout policy is catalogued.
Neural PLC and codec variants belong to the conditional codec/packetization category; they are not an ENG-03 method family.
No ML asset, weight, runtime or evaluation is present, so there is no missing ML result to promote.
missing_evidence: No catalogued ML family exists to evaluate; any future learned playout policy needs its own category record, rights scope and matched cohort.
